description: This file contains helper functions for handling challenges, including GraphQL queries, challenge data combination, error handling, and string processing, specific to daily coding challenges in a coding platform.

methods.name: queryGraphQL
methods.description: Performs a GraphQL query to the specified endpoint and returns the JSON response, throwing an error if no challenges are found.

methods.name: fetchChallenges
methods.description: Fetches challenge data for either JavaScript or Python challenges using a GraphQL query.

methods.name: combineChallenges
methods.description: Combines JavaScript and Python challenge data into a single challenge object, ensuring consistency and formatting.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Logs an error, attempts to close the MongoDB client, and exits the process.

methods.name: removeSection
methods.description: Removes the <section id="description"> HTML tags from a string.
